headline: CleanSpark Shares Advance on Q4 Earnings Beat Despite Revenue Miss
summary: CleanSpark stock rose after the company reported fourth-quarter earnings per share that beat analyst estimates, despite missing quarterly revenue expectations.
why: CleanSpark is an American bitcoin mining and energy technology company.
